content.text:
Create an SVG logo for a generative AI company using organic shapes and neutral tones

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512" width="512" height="512">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="stone" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d9d2c7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#a39a8c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="clay" x1="1" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#c4b5a0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6f675c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="core" cx="0.4" cy="0.35" r="0.7">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4efe6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b8ad9c"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="soft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- background -->
  <rect width="512" height="512" fill="#f3f0ea"/>

  <!-- outer organic form -->
  <path d="M256 74 C350 70 432 130 438 226 C444 322 392 418 296 436 C200 454 112 404 84 318 C56 232 88 136 164 92 C196 74 226 76 256 74 Z"
        fill="url(#stone)" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- secondary drifting lobe -->
  <path d="M300 150 C368 146 404 200 394 262 C384 324 330 350 290 330 C250 310 236 262 252 218 C262 184 276 152 300 150 Z"
        fill="url(#clay)" opacity="0.85"/>

  <!-- soft shadow under core -->
  <ellipse cx="222" cy="300" rx="96" ry="40" fill="#4a443c" opacity="0.18" filter="url(#soft)"/>

  <!-- inner core -->
  <path d="M220 178 C262 160 310 186 316 232 C322 280 292 318 250 322 C208 326 178 296 178 252 C178 218 196 190 220 178 Z"
        fill="url(#core)"/>

  <!-- small pebble accents -->
  <circle cx="132" cy="168" r="14" fill="#8c8376" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="392" cy="372" r="9" fill="#6f675c" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="404" cy="112" r="6" fill="#a39a8c" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>

I made one SVG logo for a fictional generative AI company, saved as `./output/logo.svg` (512×512 viewBox).

The design uses a large organic blob in warm stone gradients, with a smaller clay-toned lobe overlapping it, a soft shadow, and a pale off-white inner core. Three small pebble-like dots add accents. The palette stays in neutral tones (sand, stone, warm grey, charcoal) on an off-white background.

I didn't rasterize it to PNG, since the tools here don't include an SVG renderer, and I didn't create any other files, so there are no intermediates to clean up.
